question: Election Commission of India is a _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**constitutional body**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Election Commission of India: 

 
 
• The Election Commission of India is a permanent and autonomous body constituted by the Indian Constitution to ensure free and fair elections. 
 
• On January 25, 1950, the Election Commission of India was constituted in accordance with the Constitution. 
 
• According to the Indian Constitution, the Election Commission of India (ECI) is a Autonomous (self-governing) constitutional body that regulates the election process in India.
